subject: Vanguard Health — pilot extension + supplemental credits request
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jill Tanner <jill.tanner@vanguardhealth.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up + pilot proposal after demo

Hi Jill — thanks again for the time today. Great conversation with your AI evaluation team. As promised, attached is a short pilot proposal and a 30‑day evaluation package that includes a $10,000 credit and priority onboarding support.

Key points: 
- Trial length: 30 days (starts on first ingestion)
- Included credits: $10,000 of inference credits (applied to hosted usage)
- Onboarding: 2x onboarding calls + one integration check-in
- Success criteria: model accuracy on your NPS routing set + latency under 300ms p95

Next steps: if this aligns, can you confirm procurement contact and whether Vanguard needs an SOW? I can also pull together a mutual action plan to keep timelines tight.

Attachment: Vanguard-Proposal-20251103.pdf

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive — East
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142
From: Jill Tanner <jill.tanner@vanguardhealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 10:02:18 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up + pilot proposal after demo

Hi Laura — thanks for the proposal and the quick turnaround. The team liked the demo. We have two product squads that need to validate this (Clinical Triage and Patient Messaging), so a 30‑day window will be tight. Can you do the following as part of the pilot?

1) Extend the trial to 60 days (both teams will run staggered validations)
2) Increase credits to $20,000 so both squads can run full volume tests without throttling

Procurement wants a clear billing contact: contracts@vanguardhealth.com — they’ll need an SOW and PO. Also, if you can provide a short mutual action plan that maps milestones to dates, that would help us internal buy‑in.

Thanks — looking forward to making this smooth.

— Jill Tanner
Director, Clinical Innovation
Vanguard Health
jill.tanner@vanguardhealth.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com, kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 08:50:03 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Vanguard pilot ask — 60 days + $20k credits — need approval

Team — forwarding Vanguard’s ask. Summary: customer requests extension from 30 -> 60 days and bump from $10k -> $20k credits. They are running two squads in parallel and procurement wants SOW/PO contact (contracts@vanguardhealth.com).

Suggested concession options for executive sign-off: 
A) Approve full ask: 60 days + $20,000 one‑time credits. Required if we want highest chance of conversion; recommend tying to a 12‑month reserved capacity commit (50% discount applied after pilot) and a signed mutual action plan.
B) Middle ground: 60 days + $12,500 credits; require 6‑month minimum commit or reversion to standard tier.
C) Conservative: Keep 30 days + $10k credits (standard).

Impact: 
- $20k credits exceed manager approval thresholds (Finance will flag).
- If we attach a 12‑month commit, net CAC payback improves, but may be a heavier ask for procurement.

Attachments: Vanguard-Proposal-20251103.pdf, MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx (draft)

Can someone confirm recommended path and whether Marissa is ok to approve A or B?

Thanks,
Laura
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com, kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 14:30:17 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Vanguard pilot ask — 60 days + $20k credits — need approval

Laura / Kim — thanks for escalating. My recommendation is option B with a tighter commercial anchor: 60 days + $15,000 one‑time credit, contingent on a SaaS PO and a signed 6‑month reserved commitment at standard Dedicated pricing (we can offer a 10% uplift discount on that commit if needed). Rationale: 
- $15k closes the gap to run both squads without completely eroding pilot economics.
- 6 months is an easier procurement ask than 12.
- We preserve the right to revoke extended pricing if any SLA/usage misuse is detected.

Requesting Marissa’s executive sign‑off for up to $15,000 in one‑time credits and approval to include the 6‑month reserved commit clause. If Marissa prefers, we can escalate to a formal concessions review but that will add 24–48 hours.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4892 — please update the concession field with the approved amount so CS can align kickoff.

— Aditya
Senior Sales Manager
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com, aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com, kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 15:40:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Vanguard pilot ask — 60 days + $20k credits — need approval

Team — after reviewing the ask and the proposed commercial anchors, I approve the following concession for Vanguard Health: 

- Pilot extension to 60 days (start at first ingestion)
- One‑time promotional credit: $15,000 applied to hosted usage only
- Contract requirement: Signed PO and 6‑month Reserved Capacity commitment (standard terms) OR a signed Letter of Intent documenting the 6‑month target to be converted to a PO within 30 days of pilot close
- Deliverable: LA to finalize and send the Mutual Action Plan and SOW; Legal to review DocuSign terms before signature

Kim — please run a quick finance impact note and confirm the accounting treatment. Aditya — update the HubSpot deal to reflect $15k concession and the 6‑month commit clause. Laura — please send the updated proposal, the mutual action plan (attached), and the DocuSign link to contracts@vanguardhealth.com.

Attachments: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx
Related link: DocuSign template for pilot SOW (please route to legal)

Approval notes: This authorization is one‑time and conditional on the PO/commit being submitted; if procurement pushes for 12 months we will re‑run economics.

— Marissa Cole
VP, Growth and Revenue
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
